listing.name: Disruptor — Disruptor Recompiled (Phroster) (Phroster)
listing.summary: The project has a native PC gameplay trailer claiming 60 FPS. This is a release candidate. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA .bin or .iso disc image. No BIOS is required; this guide does not specify the exact supported serial or revision.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the v1.0.0-rc.2 installer to build locally from your own disc. The project estimates about a minute.
